add.hint: Adds the private key (no .pub extension) to ssh-agent. Passphrase-protected keys cannot be entered here — run ssh-add in a terminal first, or use a key without a passphrase.

empty.title: No keys in ssh-agent
empty.description: Add a key to enable SSH clone and push.

agentDown.title: ssh-agent is not running
agentDown.description: SSH key features are unavailable. On Windows: start the “OpenSSH Authentication Agent” service; on macOS/Linux: run eval $(ssh-agent) in a terminal.
agentDown.retryHint: The service is still not running — retry, or run this in an elevated terminal: sc config ssh-agent start= auto && sc start ssh-agent
